measurement_notes: Capacity baselines have distinct case identities and are not paired as code improvements against original profiles.
Native progress exposes the verified executable upper; the first saved finite-upper sample is an observation time, not an exact verification-event timestamp.
Total phase wall includes native preparation, solving, compilation, independent evaluation and serialization. Runner wall separately includes process supervision.
Native peak owned bytes is solver accounting. Process working-set values are snapshots; process peak is unavailable.
Missing-frontier service_completions counts selection for ordinary refinement, not proof every selected kernel completed.
Per-node source expected_cost annotations are not used as independently verified entry values or cost attribution.
All costs below belong to independently evaluated returned graphs where evaluation status is matched.
Historical directory names containing heldout are retained; both Wand and Shield are exposed regression cases.

The full core/exposed preservation cohorts use restored solver logic with the initial description correction. CB02 exposed a preliminary-status wording issue; final status-neutral text is checked in final_publication and the final WASM qualification. Solver logic did not change between these builds.
